title: 💽 Explore PGVector and Supabase
body: We've been having some prod issues running Weaviate. We should look into PG Vector since it also has a free open source offering and also has a managed offering through Supabase

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns the agent's memory mechanism, specifically the vector database backend (Weaviate vs. PGVector/Supabase), which is a core agent component for storing and retrieving embeddings or memory. Evaluating alternative memory stores directly relates to agent system maintenance and operation.
